description: Starter HTML templates for things people share: client proposal, statement of work, pitch deck, weekly status report, project handoff, quote, product spec, research brief, property listing, event RSVP. Omit id to list them (id, job, industry, placeholders). Pass an id to get the full HTML: replace every {{placeholder}} with real content, keep the inline CSS, then publish it with publish_html. Pass team to use a team's own saved templates. Gallery: https://hushdrop.dev/templates

id.description: Template id from the list, e.g. 'proposal' or 'pitch-deck'. Omit to list all templates.

team.description: A team handle: list or fetch that team's own saved templates instead of the built-in ones (you must be on the team).

name: get_template
title: Get a starter template
